attributes.name: Nulkineth
attributes.powers:
Nulkineth is immune to the Poison trait. if the check to defeat has the Melee trait, the difficulty is increased by 3.

Only 1 blessing may be played on any check against Nulkineth.

The damage dealt by Nulkineth is increased by your Divine modifier.

"Acolytes? Still alive? They're still useful." --Nulkineth

corrections.corrected_text: On the villain Nulkineth, change "Divine bonus" to "Divine modifier".
corrections.issue: Nulkineth cares about my "Divine bonus." What is that?
